The raw event logs are kept for 13 months and then deleted automatically. Aggregated tables built from them are kept for as long as the reports that use them.

Sources:
- FCT-0002, Retention period for raw event logs, Verified: 2026-04-20 by Team lead, Review by: 2027-04-20, Data retention schedule, version 2, 2026 - https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/harbour-data/Shared%20Documents/Policies/Data%20retention%20schedule%20v2.docx
